Description
org.apache.juneau.petstore.console.ops
Petstore console operations pages: background jobs and the audit log.
org.apache.juneau.petstore.console.orders
Petstore console orders page and its JSON endpoints.
org.apache.juneau.petstore.console.pets
Petstore console pets pages and their JSON endpoints.
org.apache.juneau.petstore.console.users

org.apache.juneau.rest.server.terminal
Raw command output in the browser: a byte-offset endpoint over a TerminalSource and an xterm.js panel that renders it the way a terminal would.
org.apache.juneau.rest.server.view.freemarker.console
FreeMarker-only delivery of the admin-console chrome: the reserved-classpath base.ftlh template, the <@tag> macro, and ConsoleFreemarkerMixin (registers a reserved-path ClassTemplateLoader on top of the host's own FreemarkerMixin configuration).
org.apache.juneau.rest.server.views
A typed, declarative "rich DataTables view" toolkit that serializes to the frozen VIEW_META JSON wire contract consumed by the first-party client runtime.
